You wake up. And every bee, butterfly and flower bug on Earth is gone.
No more stings. Nice. But one snack you love is about to vanish.
Three out of four kinds of food crops need these little guys, at least a bit.
Melons and kiwis? Basically gone. Coffee and avocados? Way fewer.

text: But here's the surprise. You wouldn't starve.

Wheat, rice and corn don't need bugs. Wind, or the plant itself, does the job.
Scientists think crop production would drop only about five to eight percent.
Food just gets way more boring. And that snack?

text: Chocolate. Cocoa flowers are pollinated by tiny flies. No flies, no chocolate.
